    23	Dune: Imperium – Uprising is a deck-building worker placement game set in the Dune universe. Each player is a Leader representing one of the Great Houses of the Landsraad (or another powerful figure). You play cards to send Agents to board spaces, acquire new cards for your deck, deploy units (troops and sandworms) to the Conflict, and grow Influence with the four Factions (Emperor, Spacing Guild, Bene Gesserit, Fremen). In two-player play use an ordinary scoring Rival, rather than the two Streamlined-only Rivals Lady Amber Metulli and Glossu “The Beast” Rabban. The 10 contrasting-back Rise of Ix contracts are identified for sorting only and are not used in this scope. Shaddam’s printed setup instruction is verified against the original Leader card reproduced in the publisher’s October 4, 2023 Contracts design diary.
